record.title: Build a pinned APK-backed bounded reader and native mapping fixture
record.intent: Implement the verified container geometry without changing the read budget or original reader evidence.
requirements: Commit and push tasking before implementation. Preserve stock originals and the standalone reader source and binary.

Derive a separately named reader from the pinned standalone source using an auditable patch. Pin whole APK and embedded ELF, fixed entry offset and exact size; validate container and ELF before resolving APK-relative mappings.
Retain one readonly process descriptor, exact8/16/8/16reads maximum48bytes, repeated identity/maps/file checks, no attachment/target calls/writes or permission fallback.

Implement a disposable native fixture with private APK-backed stock PT_LOAD mappings and declared synthetic cached bytes; no stock instrument initialization. Include other same-inode APK mappings and process metadata.
Compile with pinned toolchain and exercise C resolver against preserved maps and meaningful mutations independently from Python. Freeze build artifacts and commit/push before guest execution.
acceptance: A frozen APK reader and fixture pass host controls or preserve a precise build/control failure.
